quests.title: Murakami's Meal-Making

dialogue.sit: Are you looking for some Mint?

dialogue.t: Mint, yes, Mint's what I need... With Mint, I could create whole new flavors...
I'm guessing you accepted my commission? In which case, I'm guessing you also have 15 Mints for me...?
Great, then it's time for me to get to creating some new dishes! ...Oh, but first, it's time I paid you. Almost forgot!

quests.description: Narukami Island’s Murakami would like to have 15 Mints.
